scale_up: fault-free and ((SLO breached and (demand/pod >= 0.85 c(r) or throttle >= 0.5)) or peak demand over (t, t+60s] / ready >= c(r))
scale_down: fault-free, SLO ok, ready >= 2, peak demand over [t-60s, t+180s] <= 0.75 * c(r-1) * (r-1), sustained over the trailing 60 s
masked: qa_flag != ok; cpu_hog that outlived its logged end (labels.residual_hog_mask)
demand: goodput_rps, or rps while p95 >= SLO (overload 504s are offered load)
knee_rule: decision stump per replica count on fault-free ok rows (SAFE_BREACH_RATE 0.1)

fault_gates_in_priority_order.memory_leak: (mem_growth_med_1m >= 50 KB/s and no backlog (inflight/pod < 10, throttle_1m < 0.8) and not noisy) or oomkills_delta_3m >= 1
fault_gates_in_priority_order.bad_deploy: cpr_ratio >= 1.8 and (with pods: rollout < 900 s ago and pod_cpr_disp_1m < 1.6; without pods: not overloaded)
fault_gates_in_priority_order.noisy_pod: pod_cpr_disp_1m >= 2.0 and pod_cpu_disp_1m >= 0.15 cores and no rollout < 900 s
fault_gates_in_priority_order.dependency_latency: p95_slo_1m >= 1 and p95_slo_min_30s >= 1 and throttle_1m < 0.3 and cpu_frac_limit_1m < 0.6

settled_scoring: drop rows within 30 s after a label change
